patterns: I have a runny nose and sneezing
My throat is sore and I keep coughing
I have nasal congestion and mild fever
I feel tired with a headache and cough
My nose is blocked and I keep sneezing
responses: You may have the common cold. Stay hydrated, rest well, and take steam inhalation. Consult a doctor if it persists more than a week.

patterns: I have high fever and body aches
I feel chills and my muscles hurt
I am shivering with cough and sore throat
My body feels weak with fever and runny nose
I have fatigue, cough, and headache
responses: It seems like you might have the flu. Drink plenty of fluids, get rest, and consult a doctor if symptoms worsen.

patterns: I have a throbbing headache on one side
My head hurts badly and I feel nauseous
Light makes my headache worse
I feel sensitivity to noise and light with headache
I get frequent severe headaches
responses: You may be experiencing a migraine. Avoid bright lights, get rest, and consult a doctor for proper medication.

patterns: I feel thirsty all the time and urinate often
I am losing weight without trying
I feel very tired and hungry frequently
My vision is blurry and I have slow-healing wounds
I have frequent urination and increased thirst
responses: These symptoms are related to diabetes. Please consult a healthcare professional for blood sugar testing and medical advice.

patterns: I get frequent headaches and dizziness
I feel chest discomfort and blurred vision
My blood pressure readings are always high
I feel shortness of breath with anxiety
Sometimes I feel pounding in my ears or neck
responses: You may have high blood pressure. Reduce salt intake, manage stress, and consult your doctor for a proper checkup.

patterns: I have trouble breathing and wheezing
I feel tightness in my chest and shortness of breath
I cough especially at night or after exercise
My breathing becomes difficult in cold air
I use an inhaler for my breathing problem
responses: You might be experiencing asthma symptoms. Avoid triggers, use prescribed inhalers, and visit your doctor regularly.

patterns: I feel tired and weak all the time
I get dizzy when I stand up
My skin looks pale and I have cold hands
I feel short of breath and fatigued
I have brittle nails and low energy
responses: You might be anemic. Eat iron-rich foods like spinach and consult your doctor for a blood test.

patterns: I have loss of smell and taste
I am coughing with fever and sore throat
I have body pain, fatigue, and dry cough
I am experiencing breathing difficulty and fever
I was in contact with someone who tested positive
responses: These symptoms could indicate COVID-19. Please isolate yourself and get tested immediately. Consult a healthcare provider for further steps.

patterns: My eyes are itchy and watery
I sneeze frequently when I go outside
I have skin rashes and itching
I get congestion when near dust or pollen
My nose runs whenever I clean the house
responses: You might be having an allergic reaction. Try to avoid allergens and consider taking antihistamines after consulting a doctor.

patterns: I have stomach pain and vomiting
I feel nauseous after eating food
I have diarrhea and cramps
I ate outside food and now I feel sick
I feel weak and dehydrated after vomiting
responses: You may have food poisoning. Stay hydrated and eat light. If symptoms persist, consult a doctor immediately.

patterns: I feel sad and hopeless most of the time
I have lost interest in activities I used to enjoy
I can't sleep properly and I feel tired all the time
I feel worthless and unmotivated
I am always anxious and avoid people
responses: You may be showing signs of depression. It’s important to talk to a mental health professional or counselor for help.

patterns: I feel nervous and restless often
My heart beats fast and I sweat without reason
I worry too much and can't relax
I have difficulty sleeping due to racing thoughts
I panic in crowded places
responses: These could be symptoms of anxiety. Practice relaxation, breathing exercises, and seek advice from a mental health expert.

patterns: I have prolonged fever and abdominal pain
I feel weak and have loss of appetite
I am suffering from headache and diarrhea
My temperature remains high for days
I feel nausea and stomach discomfort
responses: You may have typhoid fever. Drink boiled water and consult a doctor for a proper diagnosis and antibiotic treatment.

patterns: I have high fever and severe joint pain
I am suffering from headache and pain behind eyes
I have skin rashes and vomiting
My platelets count is low
I feel weakness after mosquito bites
responses: These symptoms suggest dengue fever. Get a blood test and consult a doctor immediately. Drink fluids and rest well.

patterns: I have high fever with chills and sweating
I get shivering followed by fever
I feel nauseous with headache and fatigue
I have muscle pain and vomiting
I was bitten by mosquitoes recently and feel weak
responses: You may be suffering from malaria. Please get a blood test and consult your doctor for antimalarial treatment.

patterns: I feel chest pain spreading to my left arm
I have shortness of breath and sweating
I feel pressure in my chest and nausea
I have sudden dizziness and fatigue
I feel tightness and pain in the upper body
responses: This could be a serious sign of a heart attack. Please seek emergency medical help immediately!

patterns: I feel numbness on one side of my body
I have trouble speaking and understanding
I suddenly lost balance and coordination
My vision is blurred or lost in one eye
My face feels droopy on one side
responses: This could indicate a stroke. Seek emergency medical attention immediately.

patterns: I have burning stomach pain especially when empty
I feel bloated and nauseous after eating
I get heartburn and indigestion frequently
I vomit sometimes and feel full quickly
My stomach hurts after taking painkillers
responses: These may be signs of a stomach ulcer. Avoid spicy food and consult a gastroenterologist for treatment.

patterns: I have redness and itching on my skin
My skin has pus-filled bumps
I have rashes and irritation on my arm
There is swelling and warmth on my skin
I have small painful boils
responses: You might have a skin infection. Keep the area clean, avoid scratching, and consult a dermatologist if it worsens.

patterns: My joints are stiff and painful
I have swelling and redness in my knees
I find it hard to move my fingers
My joints ache more in the morning
I feel stiffness after sitting for long
responses: These could be symptoms of arthritis. Exercise gently, maintain a healthy weight, and visit an orthopedic doctor.
